summary: SCTP supports multihoming, but the failover in RFC 4960 can be slow and hurt performance. This standards-track RFC adds a Potentially Failed destination state to SCTP path management, giving a quicker failover algorithm. It also specifies a dormant state operation.

eli5.summary: If your usual road might be blocked, you start trying another route sooner instead of waiting a long time. This does that for connections that have several network paths.

questions: how does sctp failover between paths
